an5.38:1.3: ye te bhikkhave loke santo sappurisā, te saddhaṃyeva paṭhamaṃ anukampanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ.
an5.38:1.4: saddhaṃyeva paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ.
an5.38:1.5: saddhasseva paṭhamaṃ patigaṇhantā patigaṇhanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ.
an5.38:1.6: saddhasseva paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desenti, no tathā assaddhaṃ.
an5.38:1.7: saddho kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.38:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca saddhe kulaputte ānisaṃsā.
an5.38:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe mahānigrodho samantā pakkhinaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti,
an5.38:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave saddho kulaputto bahuno janassa paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti: bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānanti.
